title: Coordinates at t=2πm/(qB₀)
description: Essential: The final x and y coordinates must be correctly stated as (2πE₀m/(qB₀²), π²E₀m/(2qB₀²)).

title: Work calculation
description: Essential: The total work done by the electrostatic force from 0 to 6πm/(qB₀) must be correctly given as 2π²E₀²m/B₀².

title: Release time identification
description: Essential: At least one correct release time (πm/(2qB₀) or 13πm/(3qB₀)) must be identified for the particle to reach point M.

title: Impulse-momentum application
description: Important: The solution must correctly apply the impulse-momentum theorem during each constant-E interval to find velocity changes.

title: Magnetic circular motion
description: Important: The solution must correctly use the Lorentz force (qvB = mv²/r) to find the radius and horizontal displacement during magnetic-only intervals.

title: Kinematic displacement sums
description: Important: The solution must correctly compute vertical displacements using kinematics (average velocity) during acceleration/deceleration intervals.

title: Geometric coordinate equations
description: Important: The solution must set up and solve the geometric equations for x and y coordinates of point M based on horizontal and vertical displacements.

title: Sign/direction error
description: Pitfall: Penalise if signs for acceleration/deceleration (e.g., in kinematics or impulse) are reversed, or if displacement directions are mistaken.

title: Unit consistency check
description: Optional: Award credit if the student explicitly checks or derives the units for coordinates, work, or time, confirming dimensional consistency.

title: Multiple release times
description: Optional: Award extra credit if both valid release times (πm/(2qB₀) and 13πm/(3qB₀)) are identified and justified.
